resources.string: Snapy Metrics Collection: active app habits, screen time and reels count around your camera.

Snapy Metrics Collection reads foreground app context to calculate real-time screen habits, count short-form swipes (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok and others), and power the ambient camera halo ring. It also lets Snapy execute voice-directed navigation (Back, Home, Recents). All processing is strictly on-device; Snapy never reads personal messages, keystrokes, or screen contents.
